response.overview: Comedian Jeremiah Watkins returns with CRAZY PIZZA, his third full-length stand-up comedy special. Jeremiah navigates fatherhood with an alleged serial-killer toddler, his wife's anger in the bedroom, the alternative to hitting your kids, his recent vasectomy, marriage, parenting, and all of the other toppings that go on his Crazy Pizza.  Watch Jeremiah Watkins: CRAZY PIZZA; a new stand-up comedy special about marriage, kids, relationships, sex, family, and the beautifully insane reality of being a husband and dad.
response.title: Jeremiah Watkins: Crazy Pizza
